fact_text: Multi-timeframe analysis reads the same stock on several chart timeframes, starting with the daily chart to set the main trend and then moving to shorter timeframes to time entries and exits.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '5. Multi Timeframes Explained: How to Identify Trends in PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-10)

fact_text: A trend is read from market structure: an uptrend is a series of higher highs and higher lows, and a downtrend is a series of lower highs and lower lows.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '5. Multi Timeframes Explained: How to Identify Trends in PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-10)

fact_text: The analyst names three market states: uptrend, downtrend and consolidation, where price moves sideways without clear direction until it breaks the boundary of the range.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '5. Multi Timeframes Explained: How to Identify Trends in PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-10)

fact_text: The analyst treats the higher-timeframe trend as the governing bias, so a pullback seen on a shorter chart inside a larger uptrend is read as a correction, not a reversal.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '5. Multi Timeframes Explained: How to Identify Trends in PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-10)

fact_text: Shorter timeframes carry more noise: a stock can be in an uptrend on the daily chart while the hourly chart shows several structure breaks and the 15-minute chart shows a short downtrend.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '5. Multi Timeframes Explained: How to Identify Trends in PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-10)

fact_text: Traders who watch only the daily chart may panic during a pullback and close a position that the lower timeframe shows as a normal dip inside the larger trend.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '5. Multi Timeframes Explained: How to Identify Trends in PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-10)

fact_text: On the 15-minute chart a heavy-volume bearish candle broke a trend line, price retested the broken line from below and then fell, which the analyst cited as confirmation of the downside move.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '5. Multi Timeframes Explained: How to Identify Trends in PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-10)

fact_text: After a fall, a support zone formed on the hourly chart and price respected it; the analyst waited for a break above the prior swing high before entering, with the stop placed below the support.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '5. Multi Timeframes Explained: How to Identify Trends in PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-10)

fact_text: The analyst said reward-to-risk ratios of about 3:1 were achievable on the setups he showed, with the stop placed beyond the structure level that invalidates the idea.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '5. Multi Timeframes Explained: How to Identify Trends in PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-10)

fact_text: The analyst suggested taking part of a position off at an initial target and trailing the remainder up the price structure toward a further level.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '5. Multi Timeframes Explained: How to Identify Trends in PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-10)
